**STOP — needs B ruling on A-R439-REVIEW-M1-RD2-SF2-WRAPPER-TAG.** The code-reviewer raised a Medium that `sketch-review.md` doesn't rule on, so the task (§2 step 1, L11) requires me to stop. Round 439 is not complete.

**The finding:** the radio check (RD2) and the search-field check (SF2) still only look at lowercase `<input>` tags. A wrapper such as `<Input type="radio" />` or `<Input type="search" />` passes both. NF2 was just changed to catch this case for number fields.

**What I measured:** I ran the mutants in scratch copies only, never in `store/`:
- **Wrappers:** W1 and W2 put the wrapper in a new file; W1b and W2b put it inside an existing owner file. All four pass (rc 0) at HEAD and on v4.1.
- **Controls:** W3 and W4 add a plain `<input>` without the shared class in a new file. Both fail (rc 1) on both trees, so the scanners do read new files.
- **Not measured:** wrappers in subfolders, and a computed `type` value.

On the placements I measured, the gap was already there at HEAD, so v4.1 loses no HEAD assertion there. I didn't pick an option; that's B's call:
- (a) defer it as a Low that is equal to HEAD;
- (b) a v4.2 sketch that applies NF2's any-tag check to RD2 and SF2.

**Applied and checked:**
- **Precondition:** K2/K5/K6 as expected.
- **Applied:** the v4.1 delta, from B's patch with matching sha256 and not edited by hand. Doc 285 edits E1–E8 were applied with B's script.
- **A1:** the 8 test files and doc 285 are byte-identical to B's expected files; the self-check grep prints nothing.
- **A2:** the covering tests pass, 7 files, 24/24. The slowest test took 1042 ms, 21% of its 5 s timeout.
- **A3:** typecheck rc 0. Lint rc 0 with 205 warnings, the same as HEAD.
- **A4:** the claims diff matches B's expected diff exactly.
- **Scoped Biome:** rc 0.
- **Not run by me:** the full suite, the build and verify; those belong to the gate.

**Reviewer's other notes:** score 8/10, plus 6 Lows, none applied; they are listed in the report for B. One is that doc line 4 already says "Completed (C round 439 PASS)"; that is B's own E1 text, so I left it. The Architecture note says no structural change is needed and the shared helper should stay. The full review is saved in `a-round-439/code-reviewer.md`.

I didn't run a separate pre-flight step. I wrote no code: the patch and the doc edits came verbatim from B. `git status` shows only the 9 granted paths. No C rows were run or claimed.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- a-round-439.md
- a-round-439/ (logs, mutant scripts and results)
